desc.zh: 反步兵部队擅长对付体积小于马匹的目标。这一特性可表现为对小型目标[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_infantry.png]][[/img]]造成额外伤害、以体重优势压制轻型敌军或对大片区域造成远程爆炸性伤害等
desc.en: Anti-infantry units have an advantage against targets that are smaller than a horse. This advantage can be a [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_infantry.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against small targets, superior weight used to smash through lighter enemies, or an explosive attack from range that effects a large area.

desc.zh: 反大型部队可以有效应对体积至少等同马匹的目标。这一特性会有很多具体表现形式，如面对大型目标时的[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]伤害加成，或者可以集聚到很小一片区域的强力攻击等等。然而鉴于大型部队的攻击一般过于缓慢且容易在近战中闪避开，所以很多部队天生便可更有效地应对这些敌军
desc.en: Anti-large units have an advantage against targets that are at least as large as a horse. This advantage can be a [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against large targets or an attack that focuses on a very small area. However, some units are simply better against large targets because their attacks are slow and easy to dodge by skilled melee combatants.

desc.en: He once believed the odachi in his hands need guard no more than one small corner of the countryside. Now an age of great strife lies before him, and at last that heavy blade leaves its scabbard for more than the defence of his own.

desc.zh: 千瓣落樱皆是刃，过处不留邪祟。
desc.en: Each of the thousand falling petals is a blade, and no evil spirit survives their passing.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 海龙马陷在阵中越久，蹄下攒的浪就越足，隔一阵便向身前掀出一道。
desc.en: The longer the Sea Longma is held in the melee, the more the swell gathers beneath its hooves, until every so often it throws a wave forward into the enemy.

desc.zh: 看准敌阵破绽拔刀疾冲，自侧后以凌厉刀势撕裂敌线。
desc.en: With blades drawn, they rush a weakness in the enemy line, tearing into flank and rear with merciless strokes.

desc.zh: 只要心中破晓信念未灭，将士的步履与刀锋便决不动摇。
desc.en: So long as their faith in the dawn endures, neither their stride nor their blades shall falter.

desc.zh: 能成为旗本的武士早已在剑术上登峰造极。
desc.en: A samurai who has risen to become a hatamoto has already mastered swordsmanship to its very peak.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 若无法守护应当守护之人，纵使苟活，武士亦与死人无异。
desc.en: A samurai who cannot protect those they are duty-bound to protect is no different from the dead, even if they cling to life.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 日神之使振翼盘旋于云端，为追随者指明破阵之路。
desc.en: The Sun Deity's messenger circles high above, showing its followers the way through the enemy ranks.

desc.zh: 海龙马自云中俯冲落地，蹄下掀起一道横贯战线的巨浪。
desc.en: The sea-longma come down out of the cloud, and the shock of their landing throws up a wave that runs the length of the line.

desc.zh: 云气从天河倾下。
desc.en: Clouds and mist pour down from the Heavenly River.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 水师的禁卫在阵形完整时攻守皆精
desc.en: While their formation holds, the fleet's guards excel in both attack and defence.

desc.zh: 尼朋人相信同伴的力量。可一旦伤亡过大，情况就会反转。
desc.en: The people of Nippon put their faith in their comrades. Once the losses mount too high, that faith turns against them.

desc.zh: 凌涛所过之处，海气随之奔涌。她在阵中缠斗愈久，脚下的潮水便愈按捧不住。
desc.en: Wherever Tidestrider passes, the breath of the sea comes surging after her. The longer she stays locked in the melee, the harder the tide beneath her is to hold back.

desc.zh: 日神之光映入玄羽神眸，伏形匿影无所遁藏。
desc.en: The Sun Deity's light fills the sacred messenger's gaze; no lurking foe escapes its sight.

desc.zh: 麒麟振鬃而鸣，天雷循其角端回应，轰击近旁敌阵。
desc.en: The Kirin tosses its mane and roars, and heaven's thunder answers at the tip of its horn, crashing down upon the enemy ranks nearby.

icon.note: 本 mod 原创图标，用 design/source 里已有的那份

desc.zh: 短兵相接激起潜藏的妖鬼蛮力，战意愈烈，筋骨愈韧。
desc.en: The clash of close combat rouses the savage might within; as their battle-fury rises, flesh and bone grow ever more resilient.

desc.zh: 龙威浩荡临九渊，万兽闻令死不旋。
desc.en: The dragon's majesty reaches into the deepest seas; her beasts heed its call without fear.

desc.zh: 巨兽当前，她只觉猎心大起。
desc.en: The greater the beast, the greater her delight in the hunt.

desc.zh: 虽然这是一支远程部队或法师部队，但一旦他们陷入近战，仍然可以发挥出不错的肉搏实力

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为夺命神器！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 那些跑得特别快的家伙会更快地到达敌军那里
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 身为领主，要有钢铁般的意志与绝不服输的气势，这样在面临险境时，麾下众将的立场才会坚定，并追随其至天涯海角
desc.en: The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.

desc.zh: 此人绝不会轻易屈膝，除非他的意志与躯体全部被彻底地毁灭
desc.en: This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

desc.zh: 那些天生便带着坚硬外壳的生物可不是那么容易杀死的，就算是强力的攻击，也不见得能刺穿他们的硬皮
desc.en: Creatures with tough hides or some kind of natural armour are tough nuts to crack - even a powerful attack may fall foul of their thick-skin.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 潮水会减慢敌人的前进速度
desc.en: The tidal currents shall slow the foe's advance.

desc.zh: 每个水手都听说过瓦格赫斯特的故事，现在他那不安分的灵魂残骸附着到了暗影幽灵号上，从而令其可以发射毁灭性的舷炮齐射
desc.en: Every mariner has heard the tale of Vangheist, and now his restless spirit is summoned on board the Shadewraith to deliver a devastating broadside.

desc.zh: 一旦被克拉肯牢牢地抓住，很少有人有力量挣脱出来
desc.en: Few have the strength to break free once the Kraken has them within its horrid, betentacled grasp.

desc.zh: 大海受到了召唤，一股巨大的潮水涌上战场，把施法者的所有敌人淋个透湿
desc.en: The sea is summoned, and a great tide coalesces upon the battlefield to drench all those that oppose the caster.

desc.zh: 战士越是显赫，就越能鼓动部下去对付最可怕的敌人
desc.en: The more prominent the warrior, the better they are at stirring up subordinates to fight the ghastliest of enemies.

desc.zh: 这位领主能够承受长时间的战斗并展现出坚韧的意志，从而对附近的战斗产生积极的影响
desc.en: This Lord's ability to withstand prolonged combat and show fortitude has a positive effect on those fighting nearby.

desc.zh: 在战场上，对箭矢、炮弹以及各种五花八门弹药的需求无穷无尽
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 不知是通过秘术还是魔法，这支部队拥有能够快速重新部署到所需之处的便捷能力
desc.en: Whether by some esoteric or magical means, this unit has a heightened ability to rapidly relocate to where it is needed.

desc.zh: 不论是加强训练，轻装行进，减少进食还是提高睡眠质量，人总有办法在一天中做成更多事
desc.en: Whether it be training harder, travelling lighter, eating less or sleeping better, there's always a way to draw more from the day.

desc.zh: 龙神统治了震旦数世纪之久。他们的权力永远不会受到帝国臣民的质疑，他们也完全知晓自己在世上的地位和角色
desc.en: The Dragons have ruled Cathay for centuries. Their power will never be questioned by their imperial subjects, who understand their place and role in the world perfectly.

desc.zh: 战略战术可以从书本上学到，但必须通过实战经验的磨练
desc.en: Strategy and tactics can be learned from a book, but only honed through experience in the field.

desc.zh: 当施放法术时，阴系法术的毁灭性魔力可以降低敌人的护甲强度
desc.en: The crushing power of the Lore of Yin reduces enemy armour strength whenever a spell is cast.

desc.zh: 当施放法术时，阳系法术的内在化魔力可以强化我方的杀伤威力
desc.en: The innate strength of the Lore of Yang increases the amount of damage done whenever a spell is cast in battle.

desc.zh: 战争罗盘从天堂引来致命的闪电，将敌人烧成灰烬
desc.en: The War Compass funnels deadly electricity from the heavens to sear and burn and smite the foe.

desc.en: The Dragons have ruled Cathay for centuries. Their power will never be questioned by their imperial subjects, who understand their place and role in the world perfectly.

desc.zh: 对于身处惊涛骇浪，犹弄潮儿的人来说，狂暴的魔法之风也无非如此而已
desc.en: The turbulent Winds of Magic can do little harm to those who have found harmony amidst its raging currents.

desc.zh: 秩序、纪律和一排坚固的盾牌，这就是击垮混沌远程火力的不二法门
desc.en: The best way to repel the chaotic flurry of missile fire is to meet it with order, discipline, and a stalwart row of shields.

desc.zh: 龙帝指挥着北方各省的每一把剑和矛，他的力量与他的意志相得益彰
desc.en: The Dragon Emperor guides every sword and spear of the northern provinces, inspiring a strength of arms to match an unflinching strength of will.

desc.en: These troops are emboldened when fighting, drinking and feasting together, although such ‘bravery’ is only temporary at best.

desc.zh: 纵使最为简单的法术，也能起到去旧换新，重唤精力，弥合伤口的作用
desc.en: Even the simplest of spells can bring forth the full bloom of renewal, reinvigorating and healing the broken and bleeding.

desc.zh: 纵使最为简单的法术，也能起到去旧换新，重唤精力，弥合伤口的作用
desc.en: Even the simplest of spells can bring forth the full bloom of renewal, reinvigorating and healing the broken and bleeding.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 要引导魔法之风必须要有强大的心灵。那些拥有这种天赋的人便成为了奥术导体，将魔法的风暴导向他们的敌人
desc.en: A strong mind is needed to channel the Winds of Magic. Those that have such a gift become arcane conduits – funnelling the magical tempests to their cause.

desc.zh: 这就是冠军勇士的力量和可怕之处，任何挡道的人在冲锋的战士面前都会颤栗难抑
desc.en: Such is the power and ferocity of the champion, that those who stand in his way will falter against the warrior's impact.

desc.zh: 有些人除了待在战场中央，到处找人拼个你死我活之外，什么都不想做
desc.en: There are those who wish nothing more than to be at the heart of battle, seeking foes to vanquish.

desc.zh: 这些强大的战士，简直强到了仅用一击就能斩掉龙首，或是仅用一剑便可刺入狮鹫的心脏
desc.en: There are powerful beings who can decapitate a dragon or plunge a sword into the heart of a griffon in one mighty strike.

desc.zh: 只有强大的领导力和钢铁般的意志才能重整部队，令战士们翻身再战
desc.en: To rally the troops and bring them back to the fore takes strong leadership skills and an iron will.

desc.zh: 在战场上，选择逃跑可能更加轻松，但是那些选择坚守阵地的勇士呢？幸运无疑会眷顾他们和他们的部队！
desc.en: On the battlefield, the craven's path is an easy one, but for those champions that choose to stand? Fortune will surely favour them and their troops.

desc.zh: 拥有这一技能的人能在战斗中轻松闪避掉敌人的攻击或摆脱缠斗，当然，前提是他们觉得战术上有必要这么做
desc.en: Those with such skills can evade enemy attacks with ease and break from combat, should they feel that it is tactically important to do so.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 眼前的敌人倒下，鲜血四溅，他随即锁定下一个猎物
desc.en: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 身为领主，要有钢铁般的意志与绝不服输的气势，这样在面临险境时，麾下众将的立场才会坚定，并追随其至天涯海角
desc.en: The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 有那么些领主，他们身上散发着力量、自信和威严，激励着他们的追随者执行伟大或可怕的行动
desc.en: There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.

desc.zh: 将法杖或是某种奥术导体插入大地之后，有经验的施法者便会有效地束缚魔法之风，从而大大降低施法事故的触发概率
desc.en: By stabbing a staff or some arcane conduit into the ground, an accomplished magic-user can earth or tether the Winds and hopefully reduce a chance of miscasting.

desc.en: A few magic-users have the ability to store the Winds of Magic for later use, increasing their spellcasting power when it really counts.

desc.zh: 那些跑得特别快的家伙会更快地到达敌军那里
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 诸神将通过我们的努力净化大地
desc.en: Through our acts, the gods will cleanse the lands.

desc.zh: 该领主希望得到平民的绝对服从，这样他们就没时间策划暴动或小规模叛乱了
desc.en: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

desc.zh: 该领主及其部下皆精于军需统筹，因此即使在逆境中也能满足军队的需求
desc.en: Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.

desc.zh: 一名优秀的军需官能有效率地配发装备和粮食，让补给能持续得更久
desc.en: A good quartermaster can ration equipment and foodstuffs efficiently, making supplies last longer.

desc.zh: 这个领主一旦出现，追随者就会感到安心，从而安抚军心并降低开小差的概率
desc.en: The presence of this Lord ensures a measure of calm, reducing panic and desertion amongst followers.
